_comment: Updater configuration. Change owner and repo to your GitHub account, everything else can usually stay. This file ships inside the release, so a value corrected here reaches everyone with the next update.
_assetMatch: Substring of the release asset filename to download. Empty = take the first .zip attached, or the source archive when nothing is attached.
_allowPrerelease: Offer releases marked pre-release on GitHub. The user can also switch this on in Settings.
_checkIntervalHours: At most one automatic check per this many hours.
_postponeHours: How long the Later button silences the notification.
_keep: Files inside the extension folder an update must never overwrite or delete.
